commits.message:
fix(layout): directory draws the worktree-aware path, gitaculous stops drawing it (#562)

* fix(layout): directory draws the worktree-aware path, gitaculous stops drawing it

Reverses #548's resolution the other way: directory carries the main
checkout's path (~-collapsed, fish-abbreviated, with the subpath and a
linked worktree's name in a parenthetical) in every bundled preset,
and gitaculous is the git state alone — it draws nothing until git
answers with a branch, instead of filling the gap with the path.
git.location and gitPath are now dead and removed; gitExpanded always
shows the repo name.

* refactor(config): restore the LAW:decomposition marker and dedupe a test fixture

High-review fixes on PR #562: the law marker on DIR_TEMPLATE's
collapse-then-abbreviate split was dropped when gitPath's logic
replaced it; GIT_QUIET_FG's comment is updated to say directory
shares it too; git-location.test.ts's MAIN/located fixture was
duplicated across its two describe blocks.

* chore(config): remove location.gitPending, dead since the gitPath template branch it fed was removed

PR #562 deleted the `.git.location "path"` template branch that read
gitPending; nothing else references it.

test(ci): the colour audits write their own run's records (candybar-testing-ihvy.myy)

The audits config spreads the suite's, so it inherited the "all" run and wrote
over a local full-suite record.

test(ci): the records reporter reads lost files off the run, so -o and --shard record (candybar-testing-ihvy.myy)

Jest counts the files it scheduled after every narrowing, so the reporter takes
the lost-file count from the run and asks the search to name files only when
that count is above zero. Asked every run, the search threw under -o and read
every file of a shard as lost. The test report and upload now follow the
protocol and Rust gates, and the wall-time label says it spans the test files.

test(ci): every CI run stores one record per test file (candybar-testing-ihvy.myy)

A reporter writes test-records/<run>.jsonl, one record per file: layer, count,
duration, outcome and each case. A file jest never gave a result for reads
never-ran and a file with no test reads empty, so neither passes for the other
or for absent. test:report prints count and time per layer and the jest wall
time from those records, and fails for a run that left none. CI uploads the
records.

docs(design): the isolated daemon, tmux events and browser surface designs

Goals, architecture, contracts and one document per area, with the surveys and probes behind them. The Frame is recorded as built, and the browser surface is un-parked.
fix(bar-pane): a frame overwrites its rows and lands whole, so the pane stops flickering
